title: Consumption thresholds
subtitle: These limits apply only to this home and are used to generate personalized alerts and recommendations.

defaults.label: Use the system's default thresholds
defaults.hint: Default thresholds are set for an average household consumption. Turn them off to define your own limits for this home.

readOnly.notice: Only the home owner can change these thresholds.

scopeNote: Each home keeps its own thresholds; changing these won't affect your other homes.
cannotResetDefaults: System defaults cannot be restored yet.
